feeds.title: Senior Pups
feeds.description: SeniorPups.com has been established and dedicated to helping senior dogs around the world since 2019. SeniorPup's specialized content focus on drastically elevating the quality of life for older dogs so they can age gracefully, maintain their dignity and continue to find adventure in everything they do.

feeds.title: Rocky Kanaka » Senior Dogs
feeds.description: Read about senior dogs, their troubles, and more. Rocky Kanaka is a Pet Rescue Advocate. He travels North America raising awareness about homeless pets so they can find their forever homes. videos and social channels spread awareness about pet adoption, fostering, and volunteering with the goal of inspiring his audience to help animals in their local community.

feeds.title: Dr. Buzby's ToeGrips Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Buzby's ToeGrips dog nail grips are non-slip nail grips that improve the quality of life for your aging, special needs, or injured dog. They fit onto your dog's toenails to restore your dog's natural ability to use his or her nails for gripping and to gain traction on hardwood floors or smooth surfaces.

feeds.title: Heaven At Home » Senior Dog & Cat Tips
feeds.description: Learn more about senior dogs, tips, troubles they face, and more. Heaven at Home is an at-home pet hospice and euthanasia service that attends to companion animals in need of aid during end-of-life transition. Founded by Dr. Laurie Brush, who was one of the first certified home hospice veterinarians certified by the International Association of Animal Hospice & Palliative Care, Heaven at Home is focused on ensuring a high quality of life for all companion animals.

feeds.title: Senior Tail Waggers Blog
feeds.description: At Senior Tail Waggers, our mission is to change that. Our content is written by experienced veterinarians who have not only graduated from the best veterinary schools but also have years of experience practicing veterinary medicine. To ensure medical accuracy and completeness, most of our articles are also reviewed and approved by our Medical Directors - because we believe that multiple perspectives can improve the quality of our healthcare information.

feeds.title: Dog Quality Blog
feeds.description: Get information on senior dog care through informative health-related articles, personal experiences as a senior dog parent, and product reviews. Dog Quality, a Canadian-based company, has been helping senior dogs around the world since 2011. Our specialized products focus on improving the quality of life for older dogs so they can age gracefully, retain their dignity and continue to find adventure in everything they do.

feeds.title: Elderly Pet Blog » Senior Dog
feeds.description: Our blog provides information & education about elderly & senior pets. The Elderly Pet Organization is a non-profit organization whose mission is to provide information and education about senior pets. Our goal is to end senior pet abandonment and premature euthanization while increasing senior pet adoptions throughout the US.

feeds.title: Oakland Veterinary Blog » Senior Pet Care
feeds.description: Explore our blog to know more about senior dogs, their pain, and more. Oakland Veterinary Referral Services is dedicated to providing superb specialty care for pets while offering helpful information and resources to their owners. With more than 20 board-certified veterinary specialists and experienced emergency doctors, our multi-specialty referral center is ready to provide any kind of emergency and specialty veterinary care at any time of day or night.

feeds.title: Senior Dog Revolution Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on the latest tips, tricks, and topics impacting our senior dogs through the Senior Dog Revolution blog. At SDR, we are firm believers that senior pets are the most inspiring animals in the world. And our mission is to help promote the needs of senior dogs and help pet parents create a life of health and happiness for their oldest canine friend.

feeds.title: The Dogington Post » Senior Dogs
feeds.description: Read about the problems that a senior dog faces. DogingtonPost.com was created for the love of dogs. The site was conceived and built through the combined efforts of contributing bloggers, technicians, and compassioned volunteers who believe the way we treat our dogs is a direct reflection of the state of our society. Through the creation of a knowledge base that informs, uplifts, and inspires, we can make a difference.

feeds.title: Old Dog Haven Blog
feeds.description: Old Dog Haven is a small nonprofit group using a large network of foster homes to provide loving, safe homes for unadoptable senior dogs in need in western Washington. When we have room and the means, we take these dogs into our homes. We are committed to the belief that all senior dogs should live peacefully in their final years as members of a caring family.

feeds.title: Take A Paws With Senior Dogs
feeds.description: A platform to encourage senior dog adoption & rescue and raise awareness for Dog moms on the go, short blogs but with content.

feeds.title: Acme Canine » Senior Dogs
feeds.description: Get tips on how to care for senior dogs, affordable care, and more. Acme Canine is a blog that is focused on dogs and tries to make people understand their dogs.

feeds.title: The Grey Muzzle Organization Blog
feeds.description: The Grey Muzzle Organization improves the lives of at-risk senior dogs by providing funding and resources to animal shelters, rescue organizations, sanctuaries, and other non-profit groups nationwide. We envision a world where every senior dog thrives and no old dog dies alone and afraid.

feeds.title: Caring for a Senior Dog Blog
feeds.description: Caring for a Senior Dog is a one-stop resource to help people take the best care they can of their senior dogs. In 2015, after meeting one too many vets that didn't have the most compassionate attitude toward senior dogs, and finding the amount of information online sorely lacking, Caring for a Senior Dog was born. Since then, CFSD has helped thousands of senior dog owners successfully navigate their dog's golden years to keep them healthy and happy.

feeds.title: Old Dog Blog
feeds.description: Carol is a non-professional writer, and this is her first and only blog. When she is not parenting her dog or child, she is seeking sleep (while ironically battling insomnia). She is a runner, tea drinker, and avid reader.

feeds.title: Leon Valley Veterinary Hospital Blog » Senior Pet Care
feeds.description: Get to know about the reasons to adopt old dogs, caring for them, nutrition, and more. Our goal at Leon Valley Veterinary Hospital is to treat our clients and their pets as a part of our family. Our clients and patients are the heart of our practice and the reason we are here.
